actions.script:
StringBuilder csv = new StringBuilder() csv.append('﻿') csv.append("Trial Balance Report
") csv.append("Organization: ${orgName}
") csv.append("As of: ${asOfDate ?: 'Current'}

") csv.append("Account Code,Account Name,Account Class,Debit (${currSymbol}),Credit (${currSymbol})
")
def totalDebit = 0.0 def totalCredit = 0.0 for (def row : trialBalanceRows) { csv.append(""${row.accountCode}","${row.accountName}","${row.className}",") if (row.balance >= 0) { csv.append("${ec.l10n.format(row.balance, '#,##0.00')},0.00
") totalDebit += row.balance } else { csv.append("0.00,${ec.l10n.format(-row.balance, '#,##0.00')}
") totalCredit += -row.balance } } csv.append("
"TOTAL",,"${ec.l10n.format(totalDebit, '#,##0.00')}","${ec.l10n.format(totalCredit, '#,##0.00')}"
")
ec.web.response.setContentType("text/csv; charset=utf-8") ec.web.response.setHeader("Content-Disposition", "attachment; filename="TrialBalance.csv"") ec.web.response.writer.write(csv.toString()) ec.web.response.writer.flush()
